results.question: Following the introduction of mandatory physical inspections for machinery in 2023-06-01, what specific documentation requirement was added one year later to the post-installation process?
results.ground_truth_answer: In 2024-06-06, the documentation requirements were expanded to mandate the submission of BEPZA-issued Investment Permits (IP) as part of the formal machinery installation and inclusion process.
